facts.fact: librarium 内景：穹顶藏书溢架、Cias 自制桌椅，但村里几乎无人来听课
facts.anchor: hardly anyone in Deadhaven attended his teachings

facts.fact: Cias 终生研究 Guardian 与其 Chosen 之间的 soul-link
facts.anchor: I have dedicated my entire life to learning everything I can about the soul-link

facts.fact: soul-link 规则：守护兽一生只缔结一次，是灵魂相融，一方死另一方也死，且无需征得同意
facts.anchor: a Guardian will only create a soul-link once in its entire lifespan

facts.fact: 古籍明文：Chosen 继承守护兽全部力量、近乎永生——Inara 追问「我是不死的？」
facts.anchor: The Chosen shall inherit all the powers of its Guardian

facts.fact: 黑暗战争史：Cursed King 是 Syphon、吸干 Tolanaa 成死国；战后 syphon 能力被全境法令判死
facts.anchor: A formal decree was issued and signed by the kings and queens of the kingdoms, officially outlawing the ability.

facts.fact: Inara 的母亲每晚讲黑暗战争的故事，就是为让她明白身为 Syphon 意味着什么——她自己是 Syphon
facts.anchor: trying to make sure she understood the severity of what it meant to be a Syphon.

facts.fact: 巨龙疑为黑暗战争幸存的 One of the Three，名字叫 Fraener，王室本有人 reserved 要与它缔结
facts.anchor: If I’m right, and he is who I think he is, his name is Fraener.

facts.fact: Cias 的忠告：骑上龙就跑——王室腐朽会把 Shielder 拧成杀戮工具，Arelia 绝不会放她走
facts.anchor: Get on the back of that dragon and run.
